scope: Partial development evidence; no external reviews

scenarios.title: Повторні голоси однієї людини
scenarios.attackerCapabilities: Concurrent requests, multiple providers/devices, old backup
scenarios.trustBoundary: Honest eligibility issuer and authoritative ballot state
scenarios.controls: Keyed identity deduplication, fixed credential per poll, unique ballot credential, idempotent signed receipt and a no-write recovery gate checked against separately retained observations/receipts
scenarios.residualRisk: The stale ballot database accepted the same encrypted ballot as new before recovery verification. The gate detects retained acknowledgement loss, but cannot recover unretained evidence or force an operator to keep writes disabled
actualEvidence: The ballot API rejected a corrupted zero-knowledge proof, accepted exactly one of two distinct concurrent ciphertexts for the same cross-provider right, and returned idempotent receipts for five exact redeliveries
The stale synthetic ballot database accepted the same encrypted ballot as non-idempotent; recovery verification with the retained receipt then rejected that restored state before any retry
scenarios.remainingAcceptanceCriteria: Local stale-restore detection is implemented. Automatic host enforcement, complete retained-evidence custody and an actual hosted backup/restore exercise remain pending

scenarios.title: Фіктивні голоси від власника або issuer
scenarios.controls: Native verification rejects a genuine foreign credential; API registration preserves the frozen roster, manifest and trustee keys
scenarios.residualRisk: Replacing the trusted roster admits an issuer-created credential without proving a person exists; independently trusted roster provenance and complete role/collusion evidence remain open
actualEvidence: The current API/native fixture accepted only the committed credential set, returned the same recovery credential, and rejected foreign admission plus roster, manifest, environment and trustee-key replacement
scenarios.remainingAcceptanceCriteria: Replacing the trusted roster admits an issuer-created credential without proving a person exists; independently trusted roster provenance and complete role/collusion evidence remain open

scenarios.title: Встановлення вибору конкретної людини
scenarios.attackerCapabilities: Operator correlates metadata or requests selected decryption
scenarios.trustBoundary: Honest trustee clients; enough independent key holders
scenarios.controls: Client Belenios encryption; native trustee guard checks manifest, aggregate, final set, deadline and minimum group; original check_factor validates each share before storage; durable one-final-set binding; receipts omit choice and participant secrets
scenarios.residualRisk: Combined identity/ballot/runtime access links a pseudonym to ciphertext; real-person mapping depends on provider evidence or enumeration. First-fork completeness, sufficient trustee collusion, compromised devices, disclosed participant secrets and unanimity can reveal choices
actualEvidence: Two independent polls proved that combined identity and ballot stores plus the runtime sealing key map the same pseudonymous voter to both accepted ciphertexts without publishing any credential or tracker
Each open native archive verified with one encrypted ballot and no result; the strict receipt contained no answer or private credential
scenarios.remainingAcceptanceCriteria: Identity-linkage behavior is now measured. Independently retained first-fork evidence, provider-to-real-person mapping review, trustee-collusion resistance and compromised-client resistance remain explicit limits

scenarios.title: Компрометація БД, логів і backups
scenarios.attackerCapabilities: Reads one or all stores, runtime secrets and backups
scenarios.trustBoundary: Runtime/host operator controls keys in this simulation
scenarios.controls: Separate DB users and origins, sealed credentials, no application request logging, public encrypted audit, fail-closed runtime disk/database binding, a two-poll compromise matrix and recovery verification against external receipts/checkpoints
scenarios.residualRisk: A combined operator can link pseudonymous participation to ciphertext and can bypass the documented no-write recovery procedure. Infrastructure/provider logs and hosted backup custody remain pending operational evidence
actualEvidence: Identity-only, ballot-only, management-only, combined private stores and public-plus-internal evidence are evaluated separately for person, participation, cross-poll, ciphertext and choice linkage
A stale restore that reopened an accepted right was detected by the separately retained receipt; rollback or missing acknowledgement created no recovery approval
scenarios.remainingAcceptanceCriteria: Synthetic compromise and stale-restore detection are covered. An actual hosted restore, automatic maintenance enforcement and production log/provider/backup custody evidence remain pending

scenarios.title: Добровільне голосування видається за думку населення
scenarios.trustBoundary: Platform controls its own UI and exports only
scenarios.controls: Strict shared result schema and publication gate; UI/API/JSON/CSV/SVG retain exact question/version, N, all answers, policy, times, verification and self-selection warning. The demand landing keeps a concise visible self-selection, no-identity and non-representativeness notice next to the action.
scenarios.residualRisk: External copies, screenshots and spreadsheet reinterpretation cannot be controlled
scenarios.remainingAcceptanceCriteria: Issue #26 implemented and merged after CI. Third-party misrepresentation remains outside platform control.

scenarios.title: Маніпуляція формулюванням і контекстом
scenarios.attackerCapabilities: Author/moderator changes official content or manipulates language
scenarios.trustBoundary: Honest review and client receiving expected code
scenarios.controls: Five-point rubric, reasoned duplicate decisions with an appeal journal, fixed official manifest/context across management and ballot APIs, retained predecessor links and client comparison; the demand assistant uses the shared FAQ as its only approved context, disables tools and web access, and has strict prompt-boundary and request-limit tests
scenarios.residualRisk: External model behavior, the broader malicious language suite and source/content removal policy tests remain pending
actualEvidence: The actual management API rejects participant review and appeal resolution, requires every rubric item before approval, records the duplicate reason, permits an author appeal and records the moderator resolution before reopening the draft

The focused lifecycle scenario rejects invalid deadlines and post-open edits, compares management, embedded and served official context, requires a structured cancellation reason and retains the predecessor link
scenarios.remainingAcceptanceCriteria: External model behavior, the broader malicious language suite and source/content removal policy tests remain pending

scenarios.title: Дублікати та захоплення каталогу
scenarios.attackerCapabilities: One confirmed author creates many paraphrased questions
scenarios.controls: Draft cap, publication quotas/cooldown/open limit; visible chronological sorting; similar search
scenarios.residualRisk: An operator with source or database control can bypass application quotas; external observation and governance remain required
actualEvidence: The actual management API accepted one pseudonymous draft and its edit through the same person recovered by another provider, rejected an unverified author, a different author, missing bilateral arguments, a missing source and editing after submission

Three distinct synthetic similar questions remained separate and followed the same explicit created-at-descending and identifier tie-break order as the nonpersonalized public catalogue; the private review item was absent
Seven concurrent paraphrased drafts sent through provider A and B produced exactly six accepted drafts and one DRAFT_LIMIT_REACHED response for the shared deduplicated author
The actual management API rejected a fourth publication within 24 hours, a publication during the configured cooldown and a third simultaneously open poll with distinct exact error contracts
scenarios.remainingAcceptanceCriteria: V010 and V018 development acceptance is covered; operator bypass and production governance remain separate risks

scenarios.title: Цензура та суперечливі історії
scenarios.attackerCapabilities: Operator rolls back DB or serves split views
scenarios.controls: Separate public observer with pinned signer/manifest, signed history persistence, known acknowledgements, closed-set freeze, catalogue/content comparison, native public result verification, minimal lawful-removal tombstones, verified static recovery and a restore approval gate
scenarios.residualRisk: Observers must exchange evidence to detect isolated forks; retained state/trust/receipt custody must be protected. Restore isolation and separately hosted snapshot withdrawal require operator compliance
actualEvidence: A legal-content incident replaced the public document with a strict four-field tombstone, removed it from catalogue and author views, and preserved only the separate reasoned incident event
A natively verified static page, result JSON and audit package were served by an independent GET-only host with no identity request; POST returned 405 and removed content produced no export
Recovery approval was created only for state consistent with retained observation and receipt evidence; missing acknowledgement and checkpoint rollback produced no approval
scenarios.remainingAcceptanceCriteria: Local observer, withdrawal, static recovery and stale-restore checks are covered. Final Browser execution, hosted recovery exercise, PR and CI remain pending; isolated-fork detection and operator procedures retain their declared conditions.

scenarios.title: Підміна збірки та непрозоре управління
scenarios.controls: Pinned upstream/dependencies, public PRs and restricted CI permissions; two-clean-client-build byte comparison; complete client manifests/checksums; CycloneDX SBOM; source/toolchain provenance; separately trusted client monitor
scenarios.residualRisk: Self-generated provenance is unsigned; independent monitor operation, selective-delivery resistance, native/runtime reproducibility and complete release governance remain pending
actualEvidence: The real HTTP monitor accepted the trusted HTML/JavaScript pair and rejected substituted JavaScript at the same path
The release command compares every full and demand client byte from two fresh source and dependency directories before writing manifests, checksums, SBOM and provenance
scenarios.remainingAcceptanceCriteria: Operate the monitor independently, sign release attestations, extend reproducibility to native/runtime artifacts and complete release governance

scenarios.title: Недоступність провайдера ідентифікації
scenarios.attackerCapabilities: A/B failure, delayed callbacks, conflicting claims and request bursts
scenarios.trustBoundary: A and B have distinct mock keys/processes; real upstream unknown
scenarios.controls: Idempotent return; same person/credential through B; conflict revokes session; production mocks refused; eight active requests, sixteen FIFO waiters, two-second queue expiry and 1,024 accepted requests per fixed five-second window per service process
scenarios.residualRisk: Production adapters AwaitingProviderContract; real upstream independence, upstream DDoS protection and production attribute contracts unverified
scenarios.remainingAcceptanceCriteria: Production adapters AwaitingProviderContract; real upstream independence, upstream DDoS protection and fresh-attribute contracts require external access. The local read profile is not production capacity evidence. Full revocation remains in V009.

scenarios.title: Купівля голосів і примус
scenarios.attackerCapabilities: Credential transfer, supervised screen, compromised device or private keys
scenarios.trustBoundary: Participant device and sufficient key holders
scenarios.controls: Pre-vote warning; strict receipts omit choice, identity, private credential and encryption secrets; storage experiment distinguishes inclusion evidence from choice evidence
scenarios.residualRisk: Belenios integration provides neither receipt-freeness nor coercion resistance. Credential transfer, supervised screens, disclosed randomness, compromised devices, sufficient trustee collusion and unanimity remain limitations
actualEvidence: The strict signed receipt parsed to protocol, poll ID, manifest hash and tracker only; no answer, person, private credential or randomness was present
Credential transfer, supervised screen, randomness disclosure, tracker use and compromised-device scenarios are individually classified without claiming receipt-freeness
scenarios.remainingAcceptanceCriteria: The declared protocol does not provide receipt-freeness or coercion resistance; production client integrity and organizational trustee independence remain separate work
